subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat direct restart recovery can route new turns into agent:main:boot after gateway restart, leaving agent:main:main failing with reply session initialization conflicted

question: After restart recovery, should every `agent:main:boot` session be categorically prevented from owning fresh user-originated WebChat direct turns, or are there supported recovery cases where it may remain the target?
rationale: The source-side conflict mitigations do not determine the durable routing contract for boot recovery sessions; choosing it affects recovery behavior across user-facing channels.

options.title: Disallow fresh boot-session routing
options.body: Make recovery-only boot mappings non-routable for new WebChat direct inbound turns and preserve the active main-session binding.

options.title: Allow only explicit handoff routing
options.body: Permit a boot session only when recovery records an explicit, validated handoff from the active direct-chat session and cover that contract with regression proof.

recommendation.title: Disallow fresh boot-session routing
recommendation.body: Make recovery-only boot mappings non-routable for new WebChat direct inbound turns and preserve the active main-session binding.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work covers the adjacent reply-session initialization boundary and they are the strongest available history-based routing contact in the supplied evidence.
